panels.title: Services up (of 4)
panels.description: Number of app services (gateway, orders, payments, inventory) whose Prometheus scrape target is up.

panels.title: Gateway requests/s
panels.description: Requests per second handled by the gateway over the last minute, without /health, /ready and /metrics.

panels.title: Gateway error %
panels.description: Share of gateway requests answered with a 5xx status over the last minute (5xx / all requests).

panels.title: Gateway p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile of the gateway request duration over the last minute (95% of requests were faster).

panels.title: Avg CPU % of limit (app)
panels.description: Average over the 4 app containers of CPU use as a percentage of each container's own CPU limit (1-minute rate).

targets.expr: avg(100 * sum by (service) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{service=~"gateway|orders|payments|inventory"}[1m])) / (max by (service) (container_spec_cpu_quota{service=~"gateway|orders|payments|inventory"}) / max by (service) (container_spec_cpu_period{service=~"gateway|orders|payments|inventory"})))

panels.title: Avg memory % of limit (app)
panels.description: Average over the 4 app containers of the memory working set as a percentage of each container's memory limit.

panels.title: Service health
panels.description: One row per service: scrape up/down, requests/s, 5xx %, p95 latency (app services only) and container CPU and memory as % of limit.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5..",route!~"/(health|ready|metrics)"}[1m])) or sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{route!~"/(health|ready|metrics)"}[1m])) * 0) / clamp_min(sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{route!~"/(health|ready|metrics)"}[1m])), 0.001)

panels.title: CPU % of limit per container
panels.description: CPU use of each of the 6 containers as a percentage of its own CPU limit (1-minute rate).

panels.title: Memory working set per container
panels.description: Memory working set (memory in active use, as reported by cAdvisor) of each of the 6 containers.

panels.title: Requests/s per service
panels.description: Requests per second handled by each app service, without /health, /ready and /metrics.

panels.title: Error rate per service (5xx %)
panels.description: Share of each app service's requests answered with a 5xx status (1-minute window).

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5..",route!~"/(health|ready|metrics)"}[1m])) or sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{route!~"/(health|ready|metrics)"}[1m])) * 0) / clamp_min(sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{route!~"/(health|ready|metrics)"}[1m])), 0.001)

panels.title: In-flight requests per service
panels.description: Requests currently being handled by each app service (gauge exposed by the service).

panels.title: Latency p50 per service
panels.description: p50 request duration of each app service (1-minute window, without /health, /ready and /metrics).

panels.title: Latency p95 per service
panels.description: p95 request duration of each app service (1-minute window, without /health, /ready and /metrics).

panels.title: Latency p99 per service
panels.description: p99 request duration of each app service (1-minute window, without /health, /ready and /metrics).

panels.title: Dependency calls/s by outcome
panels.description: Calls per second from the app services to postgres, redis and other services, split by outcome (success, error, timeout).

panels.title: Dependency p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile duration of calls to each dependency (postgres, redis, downstream services), 1-minute window.

panels.title: DB pool: in use vs max per service
panels.description: Postgres pool connections checked out (solid) against the configured pool maximum (dashed) for each service.

panels.title: Recent WARNING and ERROR logs
panels.description: Latest WARNING and ERROR lines of the app services (level label), plus error-like lines of postgres and redis (text match, their logs are not JSON).

panels.title: Log volume by level
panels.description: Log lines per second of the 4 app services by level (INFO, WARNING, ERROR), 1-minute window.
